title: Excavator Bucket
content: One of the pages in my watercolor sketchbook has a random orange underpainting in casein.It matches the orange color of the rust on this excavator bucket. I love the fact that the iron oxide of that rust is the same mineral in my raw sienna color that I use as I paint it. The wear straps and side plates are covered with mud and rust and seems to belong to the bare rocks and dirt.The teeth of the digger bucket are made from a different kind of steel. They catch blue highlights from the sky.The stiltgrass and mullein belong to another realm, one of upward growth and green.(Link to video)
